## Skills covered

-   Designing and creating a working environment for data science workloads on **Azure Machine Learning**
-   Exploring data and engineering features for ML
-   Training, tuning, and selecting models with **Python**, **scikit-learn**, and Azure ML SDK / CLI v2
-   Building **ML pipelines** and orchestrating jobs end-to-end
-   Tracking experiments with **MLflow** and the Azure ML tracking server
-   Deploying models to managed endpoints (real-time and batch) and consuming them from production
-   Monitoring models for performance and drift in production
-   Applying **Responsible AI** practices (fairness, explainability, error analysis)
